senses.en: Give food to someone or an animal, or eat food.
Food given to farm animals.
A regularly updated stream of online content.

ex.en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
ex.zh: 请在上学前喂一下猫。

ex.en: School meal programmes help feed children whose families cannot consistently afford nutritious food.
ex.zh: 学校供餐计划帮助那些家庭无法持续负担营养食物的儿童吃上饭。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为fed；feed on表示以……为食。

senses.en: A flat, round cake made by frying a liquid mixture

ex.en: He flipped the pancake and reached for the honey.
ex.zh: 他把煎饼翻了个面，伸手去拿蜂蜜。

ex.en: Preparing pancakes in cooking classes allows students to practise measuring ingredients and using kitchen equipment safely.
ex.zh: 在烹饪课上制作煎饼，让学生有机会练习称量食材和安全使用厨房设备。

col: a stack of pancakes｜一摞松饼
tip: 英式通常较薄，美式通常较厚且蓬松。

senses.en: a soft white food made from soy milk

ex.en: My grandma cooks beancurd with fresh vegetables every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我奶奶每个周日都用新鲜蔬菜做豆腐。

ex.en: Beancurd is a cheap and healthy source of protein for many families.
ex.zh: 对许多家庭来说，豆腐是一种便宜又健康的蛋白质来源。

col: a piece of beancurd｜一块豆腐
tip: beancurd即tofu，英式拼写常写作 bean curd，美式多用tofu。

senses.en: Not including a particular person or thing.
Used to introduce a fact limiting what was just said.

ex.en: Everyone except my brother wanted to walk home.
ex.zh: 除了我弟弟，大家都想走路回家。

ex.en: The proposed transport policy benefits most residents, except those living in remote rural communities.
ex.zh: 拟议的交通政策惠及大多数居民，但偏远农村社区的居民除外。

tip: except排除在外；besides表示另外还包括。

senses.en: Continuing up to a particular time without stopping or changing.
Not moving.
Despite what has just been said.

ex.en: It is nearly midnight, but my sister is still awake.
ex.zh: 快到午夜了，可我姐姐还醒着。

ex.en: Despite improvements in public transport, many commuters still rely on private cars because services remain unreliable in rural areas.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，许多通勤者仍依赖私家车，因为农村地区的公共交通服务依然不可靠。

tip: 表“仍然”时，通常放实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: very small compared to others of its kind
a very short skirt or a small car

ex.en: She bought a mini skirt for the summer.
ex.zh: 她买了一条迷你裙夏天穿。

ex.en: The school library has a mini computer lab where students can do research.
ex.zh: 学校图书馆有一个小型计算机实验室，学生可以在那里做研究。

tip: 常作前缀构成新词，如minibus（小巴）、miniskirt（迷你裙）。

senses.en: Recently produced or picked, and not preserved or stale.
Clean, cool, and pleasant, especially when describing air.
New or different from what existed or was used before.

ex.en: I bought fresh strawberries from the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我在市场买了新鲜草莓。

ex.en: Access to fresh fruit and vegetables is essential for improving diets in low-income urban communities.
ex.zh: 让城市低收入社区居民能获得新鲜果蔬，对改善其饮食至关重要。

tip: fresh water指淡水；fresh air指新鲜空气。

senses.en: to sleep longer than you planned

ex.en: I overslept and had to run to the bus stop.
ex.zh: 我睡过头了，只好一路跑到公交站。

ex.en: Students who oversleep often miss breakfast and feel tired in the first class.
ex.zh: 睡过头学生常常吃不上早饭，第一节课就觉得很累。

col: oversleep by an hour｜睡过头一小时
oversleep and miss the bus｜睡过头误了公交车
tip: oversleep 是动词，过去式 overslept；名词是 sleep，不能说 oversleep 作名词。

senses.en: A punctuation mark separating parts of a sentence or list.

ex.en: I added a comma to make the sentence clearer.
ex.zh: 我加了一个逗号，让句子更清楚。

ex.en: A misplaced comma can change the meaning of a sentence and confuse readers of academic writing.
ex.zh: 位置不当的逗号可能改变句意，使学术文章的读者产生困惑。

col: a misplaced comma｜位置不当的逗号
separate items with commas｜用逗号分隔各项
tip: comma是逗号，句号通常叫full stop（英）或period（美）。

senses.en: a shop where men get their hair cut

ex.en: He gets a haircut at the barbershop near his home.
ex.zh: 他在家附近的理发店理发。

ex.en: Many old barbershops are disappearing because people now book haircuts online.
ex.zh: 许多老理发店正在消失，因为人们现在网上预约理发。

col: go to the barbershop｜去理发店
tip: barbershop 常指男士理发店；女理发店多用 hair salon。

senses.en: To damage something so badly that it cannot be used.
To completely end something valuable, such as trust or hope.

ex.en: A sudden storm destroyed the old shed behind our house.
ex.zh: 一场突如其来的暴风雨摧毁了我们屋后的旧棚子。

ex.en: Uncontrolled urban expansion can destroy natural habitats and threaten the survival of species that depend on them.
ex.zh: 不受控制的城市扩张会摧毁自然栖息地，威胁依赖这些栖息地的物种生存。

tip: destroy比damage程度重，通常指彻底毁坏。

senses.en: A university teacher, especially one holding a senior academic position.

ex.en: Our professor brought ancient coins to class today.
ex.zh: 我们的教授今天带了古钱币来上课。

ex.en: The professor encouraged students to evaluate different sources before drawing conclusions about climate policy.
ex.zh: 这位教授鼓励学生在对气候政策下结论之前评估不同的信息来源。

tip: 英国通常指高级职称；美国也泛指大学教师。

senses.en: one of two earpieces worn over the ears for listening

ex.en: I wear headphones so my music won't disturb anyone.
ex.zh: 我戴着耳机听音乐，这样就不会打扰别人。

ex.en: Students using headphones in shared study spaces should keep the volume low to protect their hearing.
ex.zh: 在公共学习空间使用耳机的学生应保持较低音量，以保护听力。

col: a pair of headphones｜一副耳机
tip: 日常说耳机通常用复数headphones，一副用a pair of。

senses.en: To become better or make something better.

ex.en: My cooking has improved since I started practising daily.
ex.zh: 自从开始每天练习，我的厨艺进步了。

ex.en: Investing in teacher training can improve educational outcomes, especially in schools serving disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 投资教师培训可以改善教育成果，尤其是在服务弱势社区的学校中。

col: improve access to｜改善获取……的机会
improve living standards｜提高生活水平
tip: 既可及物也可不及物：improve skills；skills improve。

senses.en: Soft white plant fibres used to make thread and fabric.
Fabric or thread made from cotton fibres.

ex.en: This cotton shirt feels soft even after many washes.
ex.zh: 这件棉衬衫洗了很多次后摸起来仍然很柔软。

ex.en: Cotton production can place considerable pressure on water supplies, particularly in regions with limited rainfall.
ex.zh: 棉花生产会给供水带来相当大的压力，尤其是在降雨量有限的地区。

tip: 通常不可数；cotton shirt中cotton作名词定语。

senses.en: The way people know, feel about, and treat each other.
A connection between things or the way they affect each other.

ex.en: She has a warm relationship with her younger sister.
ex.zh: 她和妹妹的关系很亲密。

ex.en: Researchers are investigating the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在调查城市社区中绿地的可及性与心理健康之间的关系。

col: the relationship between A and B｜甲与乙之间的关系
tip: 与某人的关系用with；两者关系用between。

senses.en: With something added to an amount or group.
An advantage or positive feature.
Greater than zero, especially when describing temperatures.

ex.en: The room costs sixty pounds plus breakfast each night.
ex.zh: 房间每晚六十英镑，早餐另收费。

ex.en: Affordable housing plus reliable public transport can make expanding cities more accessible to workers on modest incomes.
ex.zh: 经济适用的住房加上可靠的公共交通，能让收入不高的劳动者更容易在扩张中的城市生活。

tip: plus作名词表示优点时可数，如a big plus。

senses.en: things you throw away because you do not need them
to throw something away or ruin it

ex.en: Please put the trash in the bin before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前请把垃圾放进垃圾桶。

ex.en: Students collected trash from the beach to show how plastic harms sea life.
ex.zh: 学生们在海滩捡垃圾，展示塑料如何危害海洋生物。

tip: trash 为美式用语，英式常说 rubbish；作动词指“丢弃”。

senses.en: Music with strong rhythms and often freely invented melodies.

ex.en: We listened to jazz while cooking dinner together.
ex.zh: 我们一起做晚饭时听了爵士乐。

ex.en: Community jazz festivals can attract visitors while giving local musicians valuable opportunities to perform.
ex.zh: 社区爵士音乐节既能吸引游客，也能为当地音乐人提供宝贵的演出机会。

tip: 表示音乐类型时通常不可数，不加 a。

senses.en: A unit of mass equal to one thousand grams.

ex.en: We bought a kilogramme of apples at the market.
ex.zh: 我们在市场买了一公斤苹果。

ex.en: Producing a kilogramme of beef generally requires more water than producing the same weight of vegetables.
ex.zh: 生产一公斤牛肉通常比生产同等重量的蔬菜需要更多的水。

col: a kilogramme of rice｜一公斤大米
tip: 英式拼写变体；kilogram更常用，符号kg不加s。

senses.en: a round vegetable with layers and a strong smell

ex.en: Chopping this onion is making my eyes water again.
ex.zh: 切这个洋葱又让我流眼泪了。

ex.en: Growing onions and other vegetables locally can shorten supply chains and provide communities with fresher produce.
ex.zh: 在本地种植洋葱等蔬菜可以缩短供应链，为社区提供更新鲜的农产品。

tip: 开头是元音音素，单数前用an：an onion。

senses.en: to put things in a bag for a trip
a small container or a group of things sold together

ex.en: I need to pack my clothes before the school trip.
ex.zh: 学校旅行前我得把衣服收拾好。

ex.en: Every year volunteers pack food and warm clothes for families in need.
ex.zh: 每年志愿者都会为困难家庭打包食物和保暖衣物。

tip: pack 既可作动词也可作名词；a pack of 表示“一包/一群”。

senses.en: severe weather with strong winds and rain, snow, or thunder
to move somewhere angrily and forcefully
a sudden wave of strong public anger or criticism

ex.en: We stayed indoors while the storm shook the windows.
ex.zh: 暴风雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。

ex.en: Coastal communities need stronger flood defences to protect homes and essential services during severe storms.
ex.zh: 沿海社区需要更坚固的防洪设施，以在强风暴期间保护住房和基本公共服务。

col: a storm of protest｜抗议浪潮
storm out of the room｜怒气冲冲地走出房间
tip: storm out表示愤然离开，不是风暴向外移动。

senses.en: An area around people's homes within a town or city.
The people living in a particular local area.

ex.en: A small bakery has just opened in our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 我们街区刚开了一家小面包店。

ex.en: Investing in neighbourhood parks can improve residents' health while creating opportunities for people to meet and socialise.
ex.zh: 投资建设社区公园可以改善居民健康，同时创造见面和社交的机会。

tip: 英式拼写为neighbourhood，美式为neighborhood。

senses.en: Having little distance between opposite sides or surfaces.
Having little body fat or flesh.
To make or become less dense, thick, or numerous.

ex.en: I wore a thin jacket and felt cold outside.
ex.zh: 我穿了件薄外套，在外面觉得冷。

ex.en: Thin layers of insulation can improve energy efficiency without significantly reducing the usable space inside buildings.
ex.zh: 薄层隔热材料能提高能源效率，同时不会明显减少建筑内部的可用空间。

tip: 形容身材时，thin不一定褒义；slim通常含赞美。

senses.en: To produce words or images on paper using a machine
Letters and words produced on paper by printing
A mark left by something pressed against a surface

ex.en: Could you print two copies of this recipe?
ex.zh: 你能把这份食谱打印两份吗？

ex.en: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to print assignments only when physical copies are necessary.
ex.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生仅在需要纸质版时打印作业，以减少纸张浪费。

col: in print｜已出版且仍可购得
tip: print out指打印出来；out of print则指书已绝版。

senses.en: agreement allowing someone to do something

ex.en: You need permission to borrow your sister's bicycle.
ex.zh: 你得先征得姐姐同意，才能借她的自行车。

ex.en: Researchers must obtain permission from participants before collecting personal information for a scientific study.
ex.zh: 研究人员为科学研究收集个人信息前，必须征得参与者同意。

col: permission to do something｜做某事的许可
tip: 通常不可数；说give permission，不加a。

senses.en: feeling tired and ready to sleep
quiet and having very little activity

ex.en: I felt sleepy after lunch and took a short nap.
ex.zh: 午饭后我觉得困，就小睡了一会儿。

ex.en: Students who feel sleepy during lessons may struggle to concentrate and retain new information effectively.
ex.zh: 上课时感到困倦的学生可能难以集中注意力，也难以有效记住新知识。

tip: sleepy是想睡的；asleep是已经睡着的。

senses.en: Suffering from an illness or feeling unwell.
Feeling that you might vomit.
Very annoyed or tired of someone or something.

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he felt sick this morning.
ex.zh: 他今天早上觉得不舒服，所以一直躺在床上。

ex.en: Paid sick leave allows employees to recover at home and reduces the spread of infections in workplaces.
ex.zh: 带薪病假让员工能在家康复，并减少感染在工作场所传播。

col: call in sick｜打电话请病假
tip: 英式英语中be sick常指呕吐，feel sick常指恶心。

senses.en: not curved or bent
directly, without turning or stopping
honest and clear rather than hiding the truth

ex.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
ex.zh: 用尺子画一条直线。

ex.en: Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.
ex.zh: 在山区修建笔直的道路可能成本高昂，还可能破坏自然栖息地。

col: a straight answer｜直截了当的回答
tip: straight本身可作副词，不用加-ly。

senses.en: Work done to keep a home clean and tidy.

ex.en: We share the housework so nobody spends Sunday cleaning alone.
ex.zh: 我们分担家务，这样就没人需要独自在周日打扫了。

ex.en: Sharing housework fairly allows family members to balance paid employment with responsibilities at home more effectively.
ex.zh: 公平分担家务可以让家庭成员更有效地平衡有偿工作与家庭责任。

tip: 不可数，不能说a housework；做家务用do。

senses.en: a word naming a person, place, thing, quality, or idea

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to circle every noun.
ex.zh: 老师让我们把每个名词都圈出来。

ex.en: Understanding whether a noun is countable helps language learners choose appropriate articles and express quantities accurately in academic writing.
ex.zh: 了解名词是否可数，有助于语言学习者在学术写作中选用合适的冠词并准确表达数量。

tip: 名词不只指实物，也可指advice等抽象概念。

senses.en: a portable computer with a flat touchscreen
a small solid dose of medicine swallowed whole
a flat stone or metal slab bearing an inscription

ex.en: I use my tablet to watch cooking videos.
ex.zh: 我用平板电脑看烹饪视频。

ex.en: Providing every student with a tablet may improve access to resources, but teachers still need suitable training.
ex.zh: 为每名学生配备平板电脑可能有助于获取学习资源，但教师仍需接受适当培训。

tip: tablet既指平板电脑，也指药片，需看语境。

senses.en: pain in a tooth or the surrounding area

ex.en: My toothache kept me awake for most of the night.
ex.zh: 牙痛让我大半夜都没睡着。

ex.en: Affordable dental services allow people with toothache to seek treatment before more serious problems develop.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的牙科服务让牙痛患者能在问题恶化前就医。

tip: 英式常说have toothache，美式常说have a toothache。

senses.en: A measure of how hot or cold something is.
A body temperature higher than normal because of illness.

ex.en: The temperature dropped sharply after the sun went down.
ex.zh: 太阳落山后，气温急剧下降。

ex.en: Rising ocean temperatures can damage coral reefs and threaten the survival of many marine species.
ex.zh: 海洋温度上升会破坏珊瑚礁，并威胁许多海洋物种的生存。

col: take someone's temperature｜测量某人的体温
tip: have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。

senses.en: A person or group that opposes or wants to harm another.
Something that seriously harms or threatens something else.

ex.en: In the story, the prince becomes friends with his enemy.
ex.zh: 故事里，王子和他的敌人成了朋友。

ex.en: Public distrust can become an enemy of effective environmental policy, particularly when governments fail to explain their decisions.
ex.zh: 公众的不信任可能成为有效环境政策的大敌，尤其是在政府未能解释其决策时。

tip: enemy指敌人；比赛对手通常用opponent。

senses.en: warm, comfortable and pleasant
friendly and relaxed in a private way

ex.en: The little cafe felt warm and cozy on a rainy afternoon.
ex.zh: 下雨的午后，这家小咖啡馆里感觉温暖又舒适。

ex.en: She turned her small room into a cozy place with soft lights and warm blankets.
ex.zh: 她用柔和的灯光和温暖的毯子把小房间变成了一个舒适的地方。

tip: 英式拼写为cosy；美式写作cozy，考试两种都可能出现。

senses.en: The sport of travelling down snowy slopes on one board.

ex.en: I tried snowboarding yesterday and landed in soft snow.
ex.zh: 昨天我尝试了单板滑雪，摔进了松软的雪里。

ex.en: Snowboarding lessons should include safety training so that beginners can share mountain slopes responsibly.
ex.zh: 单板滑雪课程应包含安全训练，让初学者能负责任地与他人共用山坡雪道。

tip: snowboarding双脚固定在一块板上，区别于双板滑雪。

senses.en: to move over ice or ground wearing special wheeled or bladed shoes
a boot with a blade or wheels for moving smoothly

ex.en: We skate around the rink every Saturday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们每周六下午都在溜冰场滑冰。

ex.en: Public facilities where children can skate safely encourage physical activity and provide affordable recreation for families.
ex.zh: 供儿童安全滑冰的公共设施能鼓励体育活动，并为家庭提供经济实惠的娱乐选择。

col: a pair of skates｜一双溜冰鞋
tip: 鞋子常用复数skates；go skating表示去滑冰。

senses.en: an idea or detail expressed in speech or writing
the sharp, narrow end of something
show a direction or object with a finger or tool

ex.en: You made a good point about sharing the kitchen.
ex.zh: 关于共用厨房，你说得很有道理。

ex.en: The main point of this argument is that education should remain accessible to everyone.
ex.zh: 这一论证的核心观点是，每个人都应能获得教育机会。

tip: make a point是提出观点；point at是指着。

senses.en: not any of the people or things being considered
not at all, used before certain comparative expressions

ex.en: I checked the biscuit tin, but there were none left.
ex.zh: 我看了看饼干罐，但一块也没剩下。

ex.en: Although several solutions were proposed, none addressed the underlying causes of inequality in access to education.
ex.zh: 虽然提出了多种解决办法，但没有一种触及教育机会不平等的根本原因。

col: none other than｜正是；不是别人而是
tip: none可独立用；修饰名词用no，如no books。

senses.en: The vast salt water covering much of Earth's surface.

ex.en: We watched the sun rise over the ocean.
ex.zh: 我们看着太阳从海面上升起。

ex.en: Plastic waste entering the ocean threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human health through food chains.
ex.zh: 进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生动物，并最终可能通过食物链影响人类健康。

tip: ocean通常比sea范围大；专名常加the。

senses.en: Enjoyable or comfortable to experience.
Friendly and polite towards other people.

ex.en: We enjoyed a pleasant walk beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边愉快地散了步。

ex.en: Public gardens provide pleasant spaces where residents can exercise, socialise, and escape the pressures of urban life.
ex.zh: 公共花园提供舒适宜人的空间，让居民锻炼、社交，并暂时摆脱城市生活的压力。

tip: pleasant形容事物令人愉快；pleased形容人感到高兴。

senses.en: To take and use something with permission, then return it.
To use an idea or word from another source.

ex.en: Could I borrow your umbrella until tomorrow morning?
ex.zh: 我能借用一下你的伞，明天早上还吗？

ex.en: Many languages borrow words from others as international trade and cultural exchange bring communities closer.
ex.zh: 随着国际贸易和文化交流拉近各群体的距离，许多语言会从其他语言中引入词汇。

tip: borrow是借入，lend是借出；向某人借用from。

senses.en: To appear to be a certain way.

ex.en: You seem tired after your long walk home.
ex.zh: 你走了那么远的路回家，看起来很累。

ex.en: Although online courses seem convenient, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers and classmates.
ex.zh: 尽管网络课程似乎很方便，一些学习者仍能从与老师和同学的直接互动中获益更多。

tip: 常用seem＋形容词或seem to do，不表示装作。

senses.en: A code identifying a postal delivery area in the United States.

ex.en: Please include your ZIP code when entering your address.
ex.zh: 填写地址时，请附上你的美国邮政编码。

ex.en: Researchers grouped households by ZIP code to examine geographical differences in access to healthcare services.
ex.zh: 研究人员按美国邮政编码对住户进行分组，以考察医疗服务可及性的地区差异。

col: enter a ZIP code｜输入邮政编码
ZIP code lookup｜邮政编码查询
ZIP code area｜邮政编码区域
tip: 用于美国；英国通常说postcode，统称postal code。
note: 已将非标准连写zipcode规范为ZIP code。

senses.en: A flat board used to support or store things.
A broad, relatively flat area of rock or seabed.

ex.en: Put the clean cups on the shelf above the sink.
ex.zh: 把干净杯子放在水槽上方的架子上。

ex.en: Placing healthy snacks on shelves at eye level may encourage shoppers to make more nutritious food choices.
ex.zh: 把健康零食摆在与视线齐平的货架上，可能促使购物者选择更有营养的食品。

tip: 复数是shelves；shelf life指保质期。

senses.en: The language spoken in Portugal, Brazil, and several other countries
Relating to Portugal, its people, or their language
The people of Portugal, considered as a group

ex.en: My neighbour speaks Portuguese with her family at home.
ex.zh: 我的邻居在家和家人说葡萄牙语。

ex.en: Learning Portuguese can help students access a wider range of literature and international career opportunities.
ex.zh: 学习葡萄牙语能帮助学生接触更广泛的文学作品，并获得国际就业机会。

tip: 首字母大写；单个葡萄牙人用a Portuguese person。

senses.en: Despite what has happened or what someone has said.
Used to add a reason or return to the main subject.

ex.en: It started raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
ex.zh: 虽然开始下雨了，但我们还是去散步了。

ex.en: Some residents oppose the new railway, but the government intends to proceed anyway because of its economic benefits.
ex.zh: 一些居民反对修建新铁路，但政府考虑到其经济效益，仍打算推进项目。

col: do it anyway｜无论如何还是去做
thanks anyway｜不管怎样还是谢谢你
tip: anyway是副词；any way指任何方式。

senses.en: A cosmetic applied to lips to give them colour.

ex.en: She put on red lipstick before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 她出门前涂了红色口红。

ex.en: Cosmetics companies are developing refillable lipstick containers to reduce packaging waste and respond to environmental concerns.
ex.zh: 化妆品公司正在开发可替换内芯的口红管，以减少包装废弃物并回应环保关切。

col: a tube of lipstick｜一管口红
tip: 物质义不可数；一管口红用a tube of lipstick。

senses.en: an appliance used for cooking food

ex.en: The soup is bubbling in a pot on the cooker.
ex.zh: 锅里的汤正在炉灶上咕嘟咕嘟地冒泡。

ex.en: Replacing an inefficient cooker with a modern appliance can reduce household energy consumption over time.
ex.zh: 用现代设备替换低效炉灶，长远来看可以减少家庭能源消耗。

tip: 英式cooker指炉灶，美式常用stove；厨师是cook。

senses.en: Things people wear to cover or protect their bodies.

ex.en: Pack some warm clothing for our weekend camping trip.
ex.zh: 为我们周末的露营之旅带些保暖衣物。

ex.en: The clothing industry can reduce its environmental impact by using recycled materials and designing products that last longer.
ex.zh: 服装行业可以通过使用再生材料和设计更耐穿的产品来减少对环境的影响。

col: an item of clothing｜一件衣物
tip: clothing不可数；一件衣服用an item of clothing。

senses.en: the front part of your body below the chest
the stomach area of an animal

ex.en: The baby laughed and rolled over on her little belly.
ex.zh: 婴儿笑了，翻了个身趴在小肚子上。

ex.en: Eating too much sugar can add fat around your belly, doctors warn students.
ex.zh: 医生提醒学生，吃太多糖会使腹部脂肪增加。

tip: belly 较口语，医学或正式场合用 stomach 或 abdomen。

senses.en: the measurement of how tall someone or something is
the distance of something above the ground or sea
the time when something is strongest or most successful

ex.en: She adjusted the chair's height so her feet reached the floor.
ex.zh: 她调节了椅子的高度，让双脚能够踩到地面。

ex.en: Restricting the height of new buildings can protect historic views and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 限制新建筑的高度可以保护历史景观，并保留老街区的特色。

col: average height｜平均身高；平均高度
at a height of｜在……的高度
at the height of｜在……的鼎盛时期
tip: height 是名词；形容人高用 tall，物体高可用 high。

senses.en: a person who makes and repairs wooden things

ex.en: The carpenter built a small wooden table for our kitchen.
ex.zh: 木匠为我们的厨房做了一张小木桌。

ex.en: A skilled carpenter can turn simple wood into beautiful furniture for the whole family.
ex.zh: 熟练的木匠能把简单的木料变成全家人用的漂亮家具。

tip: 指木工师傅；carpentry是不可数名词，意为木工活。

senses.en: To cook food in an oven using dry heat.

ex.en: I baked some bread while the children set the table.
ex.zh: 孩子们摆餐具时，我烤了些面包。

ex.en: Schools can teach children to bake simple foods as part of practical lessons about nutrition and independence.
ex.zh: 学校可以教孩子烘焙简单的食物，将其作为营养与独立生活实践课的一部分。

tip: bake常用于面包、蛋糕；烤肉通常用roast。

senses.en: someone who grows and cares for plants in a garden

ex.en: The gardener planted bright flowers along our front path.
ex.zh: 园丁沿着我们门前的小路种下了鲜艳的花。

ex.en: Community gardeners can improve urban biodiversity by growing native plants that provide food and shelter for wildlife.
ex.zh: 社区园艺爱好者可以种植为野生动物提供食物和栖息处的本土植物，从而改善城市生物多样性。

col: a keen gardener｜热衷园艺的人
an experienced gardener｜有经验的园丁
tip: 既可指职业园丁，也可指在自家种花种菜的爱好者。

senses.en: Almost, but not completely or exactly.

ex.en: I nearly missed the bus because I overslept.
ex.zh: 我睡过了头，差点没赶上公交车。

ex.en: Nearly half of the surveyed residents supported expanding public transport rather than building additional roads.
ex.zh: 受访居民中近一半支持扩建公共交通系统，而不是增建道路。

tip: nearly表示差一点达到；not nearly表示远远不。

senses.en: at the middle point between two places or times
in the middle; not complete

ex.en: We stopped halfway through the walk to rest.
ex.zh: 我们走到一半就停下来休息。

ex.en: The project is halfway done, but we still need to check the final results carefully.
ex.zh: 项目已经完成一半，但我们仍需仔细检查最终结果。

tip: halfway 可作副词或形容词，常与 through 连用表示“在……中途”。

senses.en: likely to cause harm or injury

ex.en: The old bridge was unsafe, so the village closed it to cars.
ex.zh: 那座旧桥不安全，所以村里禁止汽车通行。

ex.en: Students should report any unsafe equipment in the lab to the teacher before starting an experiment.
ex.zh: 学生应在开始实验前向老师报告实验室里任何不安全的设备。

tip: 比dangerous语气稍正式，常与conditions, driving, equipment搭配。

senses.en: a loose top and trousers worn for sleeping

ex.en: I put on my pyjamas and climbed into bed.
ex.zh: 我穿上睡衣裤，爬上了床。

ex.en: Choosing comfortable pyjamas and maintaining a regular bedtime may help children establish healthier sleep routines.
ex.zh: 选择舒适的睡衣裤并保持固定的就寝时间，可能有助于儿童养成更健康的睡眠习惯。

col: a pair of pyjamas｜一套睡衣裤
tip: 用复数；一套用a pair of；美式拼pajamas。

senses.en: A period of one hundred years.

ex.en: This bridge was built more than a century ago.
ex.zh: 这座桥建于一个多世纪以前。

ex.en: Over the past century, improvements in sanitation have contributed significantly to longer life expectancy worldwide.
ex.zh: 过去一个世纪里，卫生条件的改善对全球预期寿命的延长作出了重大贡献。

col: over a century ago｜一个多世纪以前
the turn of the century｜世纪之交
tip: 世纪序数比年份前两位大一：如1901—2000为20世纪。

senses.en: the points gained in a game, test, or competition
to gain points in a game, test, or competition
music written for a film or the written music itself

ex.en: My score improved after a week of practice.
ex.zh: 练习一周后，我的分数提高了。

ex.en: Test scores provide useful information, but they cannot fully reflect students' creativity or practical skills.
ex.zh: 考试分数能提供有用的信息，却无法全面反映学生的创造力或实践技能。

tip: score可作名词或动词；score a goal指进球得分。

senses.en: The activity of riding a bicycle for transport or exercise.

ex.en: We go cycling beside the river every Sunday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每个星期天早上都沿河骑自行车。

ex.en: Investing in safe cycling routes can encourage commuters to choose healthier and less polluting forms of transport.
ex.zh: 投资建设安全的自行车道可以鼓励通勤者选择更健康、污染更少的交通方式。

tip: 表示这项活动时通常不可数；常说go cycling。

senses.en: one side of a sheet of paper in a book
to call someone's name in a public place

ex.en: Please turn to page twenty in your textbook.
ex.zh: 请翻到课本第二十页。

ex.en: The teacher asked us to read the first page again and find the main idea.
ex.zh: 老师让我们再读第一页，找出主旨。

tip: page 常与介词 on 连用：on page 5；作动词指在公共场所广播寻人。

senses.en: a room where children can play

ex.en: The children are playing happily in the playroom.
ex.zh: 孩子们正在游戏室里开心地玩耍。

ex.en: The new kindergarten has a large playroom filled with toys designed to encourage creative play.
ex.zh: 新幼儿园有一个大游戏室，里面摆满了旨在鼓励创造性游戏的玩具。

tip: 由 play + room 构成，类似还有 classroom, bedroom。

senses.en: To take action, behave in a way, or perform a role.
Something that someone does.
A law formally approved by a legislative body.

ex.en: We must act quickly before the kitchen sink overflows.
ex.zh: 我们必须赶快采取行动，免得厨房水槽里的水溢出来。

ex.en: Governments need to act decisively to reduce air pollution and protect the health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 政府需要果断采取行动，减少空气污染，保护城市居民的健康。

tip: act as表示充当；act还可指戏剧的一幕。

senses.en: One of the main yearly periods with particular weather conditions.
A period when a particular activity or event usually happens.
Add salt, herbs, or spices to improve food's flavour.

ex.en: Autumn is my favourite season for walking in the woods.
ex.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢去林中散步的季节。

ex.en: A longer tourist season can create more stable employment, although it may increase pressure on local resources.
ex.zh: 更长的旅游旺季可以创造更稳定的就业，但也可能加大当地资源的压力。

tip: season作动词指调味，常用season food with…。

senses.en: To give an answer without having enough information to be certain.
An answer or opinion given without being certain.
To think something is probably true, without being completely sure.

ex.en: Can you guess what is inside this little box?
ex.zh: 你能猜出这个小盒子里装着什么吗？

ex.en: Without reliable data, researchers can only guess how changes in transport costs will affect household spending.
ex.zh: 没有可靠的数据，研究人员只能猜测交通费用变化会如何影响家庭支出。

col: an educated guess｜有依据的猜测
tip: I guess偏口语，表示“我想、大概”，语气不确定。

senses.en: A schedule showing when lessons, journeys, or other events happen.
To arrange when an event or activity will happen.

ex.en: I checked the timetable before leaving for the station.
ex.zh: 去车站前，我查看了时刻表。

ex.en: A flexible school timetable can help students balance academic subjects with physical activity and creative learning.
ex.zh: 灵活的学校课程表有助于学生兼顾文化课、体育活动和创造性学习。

col: a revised timetable｜调整后的时间表
tip: 英式常用timetable；美式常用schedule。

senses.en: a telephone that you can carry with you and use anywhere

ex.en: He forgot his cellphone at home and missed an important call.
ex.zh: 他把手机忘在家里，错过了一个重要电话。

ex.en: Many students now use their cellphones to look up new words during study time.
ex.zh: 现在许多学生在学习时用手机查生词。

tip: 英式常用 mobile phone，美式常用 cellphone；考试中两者都可，但同一篇作文最好统一。

senses.en: A king's or queen's daughter, or a prince's wife.

ex.en: The princess waved to the crowd from her carriage.
ex.zh: 公主从马车里向人群挥手。

ex.en: Traditional stories often portray a princess as dependent, whereas modern adaptations increasingly emphasise her independence and leadership.
ex.zh: 传统故事常将公主塑造成依赖他人的形象，而现代改编作品越来越强调她的独立性和领导力。

tip: 可指君主的女儿，也可指王子的妻子。

senses.en: a unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram

ex.en: Add one gramme of salt to the soup.
ex.zh: 往汤里加一克盐。

ex.en: Even a single gramme of certain pollutants can harm aquatic life when released into a small pond.
ex.zh: 某些污染物即使只有一克，排入小池塘后也可能危害水生生物。

tip: gramme是英式变体；gram更常用，单位符号为g。

senses.en: having the skill, opportunity, or means to do something
skilled and effective at doing things

ex.en: I am finally able to swim across the pool.
ex.zh: 我终于能够游到泳池的另一端了。

ex.en: With reliable internet access, rural students are able to attend courses previously available only in cities.
ex.zh: 有了可靠的互联网接入，农村学生就能参加以前只有城市才提供的课程。

col: an able leader｜能干的领导者
an able student｜有才干的学生
tip: 表示能够做某事用be able to do，不用able doing。

senses.en: made of wool
clothing made of wool

ex.en: He put on a thick woolen coat before going out.
ex.zh: 他出门前穿上了一件厚厚的羊毛大衣。

ex.en: The charity collected woolen blankets to help families keep warm through the cold winter.
ex.zh: 慈善机构收集了毛毯，帮助家庭度过寒冬。

tip: 英式拼写常为woollen，美式woolen；注意双写l的差别。

senses.en: Meat from a pig's leg, preserved by salting or smoking.

ex.en: I put some ham and cheese in my sandwich.
ex.zh: 我在三明治里放了些火腿和奶酪。

ex.en: Processed meats such as ham often contain substantial amounts of salt, which consumers should consider when planning meals.
ex.zh: 火腿等加工肉类通常含盐量较高，消费者安排膳食时应考虑这一点。

col: a slice of ham｜一片火腿
tip: 表示火腿肉通常不可数；一片用a slice of ham。

senses.en: waste material that people throw away
something considered untrue, useless, or very poor in quality

ex.en: Please take the garbage out before it starts smelling.
ex.zh: 请在垃圾发臭之前把它拿出去。

ex.en: Cities can reduce the amount of garbage sent to landfill by improving recycling facilities and public awareness.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过改善回收设施和提高公众意识，减少运往填埋场的垃圾量。

col: take out the garbage｜把垃圾拿出去
tip: 不可数名词；常见于美式英语，英式多用rubbish。

senses.en: a person paid to clean buildings or rooms
a substance or device used to remove dirt
having less dirt or causing less pollution

ex.en: The cleaner emptied the bins before the office opened.
ex.zh: 清洁工在办公室开门前清空了垃圾桶。

ex.en: Hospitals should provide every cleaner with suitable protective equipment and training to reduce infection risks.
ex.zh: 医院应为每位清洁工提供合适的防护装备和培训，以降低感染风险。

col: window cleaner｜窗户清洁工；玻璃清洁剂
tip: a cleaner通常指清洁工；cleaner也是clean的比较级。

senses.en: A computer designed for use by one person.

ex.en: My PC takes ages to start on cold mornings.
ex.zh: 天气寒冷的早晨，我的个人电脑要很久才能启动。

ex.en: Providing each student with a PC may improve access to digital resources, but requires substantial funding.
ex.zh: 为每个学生配备一台个人电脑或许能改善数字资源的获取条件，但需要大量资金。

col: use a PC｜使用个人电脑
tip: PC是personal computer的缩写；复数为PCs。

senses.en: a qualification awarded after completing a university course
the amount or level of something
a unit used to measure temperature or angles

ex.en: My cousin earned a degree in engineering last summer.
ex.zh: 我表姐去年夏天获得了工程学学位。

ex.en: Although a university degree can improve employment prospects, practical experience remains highly valuable in many industries.
ex.zh: 虽然大学学位能改善就业前景，但实践经验在许多行业仍然十分重要。

col: a degree in economics｜经济学学位
to some degree｜在某种程度上
tip: 某专业的学位用a degree in；程度义常见to some degree。

senses.en: A book used to study a particular subject.
Showing exactly how something usually happens or should be done.

ex.en: I left my science textbook on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我把科学课本落在厨房桌上了。

ex.en: Digital textbooks can reduce school expenses, although some students find printed materials easier to study.
ex.zh: 电子教材可以降低学校开支，不过一些学生觉得纸质材料更便于学习。

tip: 作形容词时指典型或标准，如textbook example。

senses.en: animal skin treated for making clothes, bags, and other goods

ex.en: Her old leather bag still feels soft and smooth.
ex.zh: 她的旧皮包摸起来仍然柔软光滑。

ex.en: Some consumers avoid leather products because they are concerned about animal welfare and the environmental impact of production.
ex.zh: 一些消费者避免购买皮革制品，因为他们关心动物福利以及生产对环境的影响。

tip: 通常不可数；leather jacket中名词作定语。

senses.en: A large road vehicle used for carrying goods.
To transport goods by truck.

ex.en: A truck delivered fresh vegetables to the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，一辆卡车把新鲜蔬菜送到了市场。

ex.en: Transporting goods by truck offers flexibility, but rail freight can reduce emissions over longer distances.
ex.zh: 用卡车运输货物较为灵活，但长途铁路货运能减少排放。

tip: truck常用于美式英语，英式英语常用lorry。

senses.en: an electrical appliance that heats bread until crisp and brown

ex.en: Two slices of bread popped out of the toaster.
ex.zh: 两片面包从烤面包机里弹了出来。

ex.en: Small appliances such as toasters should be designed for easy repair rather than frequent replacement.
ex.zh: 烤面包机等小型电器的设计应便于维修，而不是让人频繁更换。

col: put bread in the toaster｜把面包放进烤面包机
tip: toaster是电器；toast指烤面包时不可数。

senses.en: A thick, slightly sour food made by fermenting milk.

ex.en: I mix fresh berries into my yogurt every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上都往酸奶里拌入新鲜浆果。

ex.en: Plain yogurt can contribute to a balanced diet by providing protein and calcium without added sugar.
ex.zh: 原味酸奶能提供蛋白质和钙，且不含添加糖，有助于实现均衡饮食。

col: a pot of yogurt｜一小罐酸奶
tip: 英式也常拼作yoghurt；通常不可数，一份可用a yogurt。

senses.en: having happened or started a short time ago

ex.en: Have you seen any recent photos of our puppy?
ex.zh: 你看过我们家小狗最近的照片吗？

ex.en: Recent advances in medical technology have improved treatment options for patients living in remote communities.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的近期进步改善了偏远社区患者的治疗选择。

tip: recent是形容词；修饰动作要用recently。

senses.en: A flat food patty, often served inside a round bread roll

ex.en: I ordered a bean burger with salad for lunch.
ex.zh: 我午餐点了一个豆类汉堡配沙拉。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce their environmental impact by offering plant-based burgers alongside traditional meat dishes.
ex.zh: 餐馆可以在供应传统肉类菜肴的同时提供植物基汉堡，以减少对环境的影响。

tip: burger也可指肉饼本身，并非都以牛肉制成。

senses.en: Closest in distance, time, or similarity
At the shortest distance from someone or something

ex.en: Could you show me the way to the nearest pharmacy?
ex.zh: 你能告诉我去最近的药店怎么走吗？

ex.en: For many rural residents, the nearest hospital is several hours away, making access to emergency care difficult.
ex.zh: 对许多农村居民而言，最近的医院也有数小时路程，这让急诊医疗服务难以获得。

col: to the nearest kilometre｜四舍五入到整公里
tip: near的最高级；作定语时通常用the nearest。

senses.en: a piece of wax with a central string that burns

ex.en: He lit a candle when the electricity went off.
ex.zh: 停电时，他点了一支蜡烛。

ex.en: Although candles create a pleasant atmosphere, they should never be left burning unattended in homes or public spaces.
ex.zh: 虽然蜡烛能营造宜人的氛围，但在住宅或公共场所，绝不能让其在无人看管时燃烧。

col: blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛
tip: 点蜡烛用light；吹灭用blow out。

senses.en: the way a person or animal acts
the way a substance or system acts under particular conditions

ex.en: The puppy's calm behavior surprised everyone at the park.
ex.zh: 这只小狗安静的表现让公园里的每个人都很惊讶。

ex.en: Schools can encourage responsible behavior by giving students meaningful opportunities to participate in decisions affecting their community.
ex.zh: 学校可以让学生有实质性机会参与影响其社区的决策，以此鼓励负责任的行为。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为behaviour。通常不可数。

senses.en: A building or group of buildings where goods are manufactured.

ex.en: My aunt works at a factory that makes bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在一家生产自行车的工厂工作。

ex.en: Governments should require factory owners to reduce harmful emissions without compromising the safety and livelihoods of their workers.
ex.zh: 政府应要求工厂主减少有害排放，同时不损害工人的安全和生计。

tip: 复数为factories；指制造产品的场所。

senses.en: Ready or possible to get, buy, or use.
Not busy and able to meet or help someone.

ex.en: There are still tickets available for the afternoon show.
ex.zh: 下午那场演出的门票还有余票。

ex.en: Affordable housing should be available to all residents, regardless of their income or employment status.
ex.zh: 所有居民都应能获得负担得起的住房，不论其收入或就业状况如何。

col: available to everyone｜人人都可获得的
make something available｜使某物可供使用
tip: available to接使用者；available for接用途。

senses.en: To want something, especially something unlikely or not currently true.
A strong desire for something to happen or be true.
To express hope for someone's happiness or success.

ex.en: I wish our flat had a bigger kitchen.
ex.zh: 要是我们的公寓有个更大的厨房就好了。

ex.en: Many residents wish their neighbourhoods had more green spaces where children could play safely and families could relax.
ex.zh: 许多居民希望社区有更多绿地，让孩子能够安全玩耍，让家人能够放松休息。

col: wish to do something｜希望做某事
tip: wish后用过去式表现在的遗憾；过去完成式表过去的遗憾。

senses.en: Movable objects such as chairs, tables, and beds in buildings.

ex.en: We moved the furniture to make room for dancing.
ex.zh: 我们挪开家具，腾出地方跳舞。

ex.en: Buying second-hand furniture can lower household expenses while reducing demand for raw materials and limiting waste.
ex.zh: 购买二手家具既能降低家庭开支，也能减少原材料需求和废弃物。

col: a piece of furniture｜一件家具
tip: 不可数：一件家具说a piece of furniture。

senses.en: a flower with layered petals, often growing on thorny stems
past tense of rise: moved upwards or increased

ex.en: She placed a single rose in a glass vase.
ex.zh: 她把一枝玫瑰插进了玻璃花瓶。

ex.en: Demand for public transport rose sharply after the city introduced cheaper fares and more frequent services.
ex.zh: 该市降低票价并增加班次后，公共交通需求大幅上升。

col: a bunch of roses｜一束玫瑰
tip: rose也可作rise的过去式；过去分词是risen。

senses.en: A small control you press to operate something
A small object that fastens clothing through a hole
Fasten clothing using buttons

ex.en: Press the green button to start the washing machine.
ex.zh: 按绿色按钮启动洗衣机。

ex.en: Emergency buttons on public transport allow passengers to alert staff quickly when assistance is needed.
ex.zh: 公共交通工具上的紧急按钮让乘客能够在需要帮助时迅速通知工作人员。

col: button up a coat｜扣好外套
sew on a button｜缝上纽扣
tip: button up指扣好纽扣；拉链用zip，不用button。

senses.en: A Christian festival celebrating Jesus Christ's return to life.

ex.en: We decorated eggs together at the kitchen table for Easter.
ex.zh: 我们一起坐在厨房桌旁，为复活节装饰彩蛋。

ex.en: During Easter, many destinations attract additional visitors through seasonal events, creating temporary employment in the tourism sector.
ex.zh: 复活节期间，许多旅游目的地通过节庆活动吸引更多游客，为旅游业创造临时就业机会。

tip: 节日名首字母大写；at Easter指复活节期间。
note: 已将节日名称的首字母改为大写。

senses.en: An area of land completely surrounded by water.

ex.en: We took a small boat to the island yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们乘小船去了那座岛。

ex.en: Small island communities often depend on tourism, but increasing visitor numbers can threaten fragile coastal environments.
ex.zh: 小岛上的社区往往依赖旅游业，但游客数量的增加可能威胁脆弱的海岸环境。

tip: s不发音；在岛上用on an island。

senses.en: The thick, fatty part of milk, used in food.
A thick substance applied to skin for protection or treatment.
Having a pale yellowish-white colour.

ex.en: She poured fresh cream over a bowl of strawberries.
ex.zh: 她把新鲜奶油浇在一碗草莓上。

ex.en: Replacing cream with lower-fat ingredients can reduce the energy content of meals without greatly affecting flavour.
ex.zh: 用低脂食材替代奶油，可以降低餐食的热量，而不会明显影响风味。

tip: cream是奶油或乳霜；cheese才是奶酪。

senses.en: good or bad things that happen by chance

ex.en: She had good luck in the exam and got a high score.
ex.zh: 她考试运气好，得了高分。

ex.en: Some people believe that luck plays a big part in success, but hard work matters more.
ex.zh: 有些人认为运气对成功很重要，但努力更重要。

tip: 不可数名词；表示“祝好运”用 Good luck! 不说 Good lucks。
